name: MC-6 mini centrifuge
summary: A benchtop mini centrifuge with a four-position tube rack and two tubes: power switch, three push buttons, a speed dial, a hinged lid, two wells, a display and a light ring.
instruction: Run the MC-6 demo: the eight steps below, in this order, and nothing else. tube_pick, tube_place and lid_close are skills System 1 publishes (get_status lists them), and all three take STOP as their target: the tube, the rack, well A and the lid are not scanned controls, and none is needed. The robot finds the tube with its camera and the lid and well A from where STOP is. First propose and run step 1 on its own. Then call get_evidence on the photo its result lists (taken just after the lift, the gripper's jaws in view) and look for a test tube with a red collar held between the jaws. If there isn't one, propose and run tube_pick on STOP again, and look again; at most two more tries. Once a tube is held, propose steps 2 to 8 as one plan. 1. tube_pick on STOP (lifts the red tube from the rack). 2. tube_place on STOP (lowers it into well A). 3. lid_close on STOP. 4. flip POWER with toward=1 (up, to ON), even if the scan reads it as on already. 5. press TIME+. 6. turn SPEED with angle=-60. 7. press START. 8. press STOP. Then report what each step did, including how many picks it took.
